<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**

      Review window: Aug 12, 2026 - Aug 14, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Leticia Ortellado_, Aug 12, 2026, 1/5: "They did not cancelled my subscription. Don't fall into their trap, they tell you that they offer you another workout for free and they don't continue with the cancellation."
            2. _DeOsha Ann_, Aug 14, 2026, 3/5: "I love the everyday workouts 💪 I just wish the BetterMe Tracker wasn't so expensive, I'd buy it."
            3. _Rachael Jacobs_, Aug 12, 2026, 5/5: "I like this app alot. When I needed to change settings the help team were quick to respond. The exercises routines are very good. I like fasting option. I use the food diary too, I would like to add the food back on to previous day option added please. I love this app a lot, it is on the expensive side tho. The account/cancellation side is very good, I don't have a fear of not being able to cancel at anytime should I wish too."
